title: Searching & Sorting
description: Find a team in a long list, first one item at a time and then by halving with binary search. Sort scouted teams by score with a sort you write yourself, then rank them the way real code does, with List.sort and a Comparator.

checkpoints.title: Linear search
checkpoints.description: Search.indexOf returns the index of the first matching team, or -1, and stops looking as soon as it finds one.

checkpoints.title: Binary search
checkpoints.description: Search.binarySearch finds a team in a sorted list, or returns -1, in about log2(n) looks, with a loop you write yourself.

checkpoints.title: Sort it yourself
checkpoints.description: Sorting.sortByScore puts an array of teams in order, highest score first, with a selection or insertion sort written by hand.

checkpoints.title: Rankings with a Comparator
checkpoints.description: Sorting.rankings returns a new list ranked by score, highest first, with ties going to the lower team number, and leaves the list it was given alone.
